"""Observe current source in disposable inputs; proposed policy is never executed.

Arguments: repository root, prewritten cases JSON, a new private output directory.
All product subprocess, network and heavy-framework import attempts are forbidden.
"""

import dataclasses
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def write_json(path, value):
    if path.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("Refuse overwrite of an observation")
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n",
                    encoding="utf-8",newline="\n")


root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
cases_path = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
work = Path(sys.argv[3]).resolve()
work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
expected_raw = cases_path.read_bytes()
packet = json.loads(expected_raw)
start = time.perf_counter()
git_reads = []


def git_read(args):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(["git", *args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,check=False)
    git_reads.append({"command":["git",*args],"exit_code":result.returncode,
                      "elapsed_seconds":round(time.perf_counter()-started,6),
                      "stdout_bytes":len(result.stdout),"stdout_sha256":digest(result.stdout),
                      "stderr_bytes":len(result.stderr),"stderr_sha256":digest(result.stderr)})
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError("Read-only source identity query failed")
    return result.stdout


commit = git_read(["rev-parse","HEAD"]).decode().strip()
assert commit == packet["base_commit"], "Observation candidate differs from independent cases"
source_names = [
    "src/reprollm/core/context.py", "src/reprollm/core/deps.py",
    "src/reprollm/core/scanner.py", "src/reprollm/core/pyscan.py",
    "src/reprollm/core/git.py", "src/reprollm/core/proc.py",
    "src/reprollm/core/registry.py", "src/reprollm/core/envinfo.py",
    "src/reprollm/rules/env.py", "src/reprollm/schemas/finding.py",
    "docs/plan/01_specification.md",
]
sources = []
for name in source_names:
    actual = (root/name).read_bytes()
    blob = git_read(["show", commit+":"+name])
    assert actual == blob, "Worktree source differs from exact candidate blob"
    sources.append({"path":name,"bytes":len(actual),"sha256":digest(actual),
                    "git_blob_bytes_equal":True})
runtime = {"python":platform.python_version(),"platform":sys.platform,
           "packages":{n:importlib.metadata.version(n) for n in ["packaging","pydantic","PyYAML"]}}
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"src"))
forbidden_attempts = []


def guard(event, args):
    blocked = event.startswith("socket.") or event in {"subprocess.Popen","os.system","os.posix_spawn","os.fork"}
    if event == "import" and str(args[0]).split(".")[0] in {
        "torch","transformers","vllm","huggingface_hub","numpy"
    }:
        blocked = True
    if blocked:
        forbidden_attempts.append({"event":event})
        raise RuntimeError("Forbidden external effect during bounded observation")


sys.addaudithook(guard)
from reprollm.core.context import AuditContext
from reprollm.core.deps import canonical_dep_name, scan_dependencies
from reprollm.core.git import GitInfo
from reprollm.core.pyscan import scan_python
from reprollm.core.scanner import RepoScanner
from reprollm.rules import env

assert Path(env.__file__).resolve() == root/"src/reprollm/rules/env.py"
env.installed_versions = lambda: {}


class ObservationScanner(RepoScanner):
    def __init__(self, case_root):
        super().__init__(case_root,GitInfo(is_repo=False))
        self.read_calls=[]
        self.explicit_candidate_calls=[]

    def read_text(self,path):
        content=super().read_text(path)
        self.read_calls.append({"path":path,"returned_none":content is None,
                               "text_sha256":None if content is None else digest(content.encode())})
        return content

    def is_analysis_candidate(self,path):
        result=super().is_analysis_candidate(path)
        self.explicit_candidate_calls.append({"path":path,"accepted":result})
        return result


observations=[]
failures=[]
product_started=time.perf_counter()
for case in packet["cases"]:
    case_start=time.perf_counter()
    case_root=work/case["id"]
    case_root.mkdir()
    for fixture in case["inputs"]:
        raw=fixture["content_utf8"].encode()
        assert digest(raw)==fixture["sha256"] and len(raw)==fixture["bytes"]
        target=case_root/fixture["path"]
        assert target.resolve().is_relative_to(case_root)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(raw)
    scanner=ObservationScanner(case_root)
    ctx=AuditContext(case_root)
    ctx._git=GitInfo(is_repo=False)
    ctx._fs=scanner
    ctx._deps=scan_dependencies(scanner)
    ctx._pyscan=scan_python(scanner)
    deps=ctx.deps
    imports=[(canonical_dep_name(i.module.split(".",1)[0]),i.path) for i in ctx.pyscan.imports]
    critical=env.LlmCriticalDepsPinnedRule()
    actual_findings=[f.model_dump(mode="json") for f in critical.check(ctx)]
    projection={
        "declarations":[dataclasses.asdict(d) for d in deps.declarations],
        "manifest_present":deps.manifest_present,
        "declaration_read_issues":deps.declaration_read_issues,
        "uncertain_directories":sorted(p.as_posix() for p in deps._uncertain_directories),
        "project_manifests":{p:sorted(formats) for p,formats in sorted(deps._project_manifests.items())},
        "lockfiles":[{"path":lock.path,"packages":sorted(lock.packages),"read_issue":lock.read_issue} for lock in deps.lockfiles],
        "qualified_lock_packages":sorted(deps.qualified_lock_packages(imports)),
        "unparsed_count":len(deps.unparsed),
        "python_gap":ctx.pyscan.coverage().pass_skip_reason() is not None,
        "critical_applies":critical.applies(ctx),
        "critical_findings":actual_findings,
    }
    full={"projection":projection,"unparsed":deps.unparsed,
          "unverified_lock_paths":{p:list(paths) for p,paths in deps.unverified_lock_paths(imports).items()},
          "pyscan":dataclasses.asdict(ctx.pyscan),
          "coverage":dataclasses.asdict(ctx.pyscan.coverage()),
          "critical_skip_reason":critical.skip_reason(ctx),
          "critical_empty_result_veto":critical.pass_skip_reason(ctx),
          "analysis_files":scanner.analysis_files(),"scanner_warnings":scanner.warnings}
    for label,rule in [("manifest",env.DependencyManifestPresentRule()),("lock_presence",env.LockfilePresentRule())]:
        applies=rule.applies(ctx)
        full[label]={"applies":applies,"skip_reason":rule.skip_reason(ctx),
                     "check_findings":[f.model_dump(mode="json") for f in rule.check(ctx)] if applies else None}
    full["read_calls"]=scanner.read_calls
    full["explicit_candidate_calls"]=scanner.explicit_candidate_calls
    assert all(digest((case_root/f["path"]).read_bytes())==f["sha256"] for f in case["inputs"])
    differences=[k for k,v in case["expected_current"].items() if projection[k]!=v]
    if differences:
        failures.append({"id":case["id"],"label":case["label"],"different_fields":differences})
    observations.append({"id":case["id"],"label":case["label"],"actual":full,
                         "expected_fields_match":not differences,"different_fields":differences,
                         "inputs_byte_identical_before_after":True,
                         "elapsed_seconds":round(time.perf_counter()-case_start,6)})
product_elapsed=time.perf_counter()-product_started
assert cases_path.read_bytes()==expected_raw
assert all(digest((root/s["path"]).read_bytes())==s["sha256"] for s in sources)
assert not forbidden_attempts
record={
    "schema_version":1,"base_commit":commit,"checked_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "command":["<REPO>/.venv/Scripts/python.exe","-X","utf8","<PRIVATE>/observe_current_structure.py","<REPO>","<PROPOSAL>/observations/cases.json","<NEW_PRIVATE_OUTPUT>"],
    "exit_code":0 if not failures else 1,"runtime":runtime,"source_identity":sources,
    "source_identity_commands":git_reads,"cases_sha256":digest(expected_raw),
    "observer_sha256":digest(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
    "case_count":len(observations),"matched_cases":len(observations)-len(failures),
    "fixture_file_count":sum(len(c["inputs"]) for c in packet["cases"]),
    "fixture_total_bytes":sum(f["bytes"] for c in packet["cases"] for f in c["inputs"]),
    "forbidden_effect_attempts":forbidden_attempts,
    "product_observation_seconds":round(product_elapsed,6),
    "wall_seconds":round(time.perf_counter()-start,6),
    "limits":["Current product only; future policy executions: zero.",
              "Direct actual parser/AST/rule observation; no complete CLI, engine, profile override, suppression, renderer, quality gate or Gate A execution.",
              "GitInfo non-repository and installed package versions empty are explicit controlled inputs; parser, AST and rules remain current source.",
              "Strict independent comparison covers all projection fields and complete critical-rule findings. Other raw observations are retained, not promoted to independent full-output acceptance."],
    "failures":failures,"observations":observations,
}
write_json(work/"current-observations.json",record)
print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ["base_commit","case_count","matched_cases","fixture_file_count","fixture_total_bytes","cases_sha256","observer_sha256","product_observation_seconds","wall_seconds","failures"]},ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(record["exit_code"])
